_about: Whole-month OEE history for Production -> Daily OEE Trend, for months before the Daily OEE uploads started. One entry per month, from SFC's Monthly UK OEE By Machine Tabular (Hours) export, parsed with parsers/oee_parser.py (parse_oee_file + aggregate_oee) — the same as a Daily OEE save. 'snapshot' has the same raw summable fields as an oee_daily_snapshots row. In the Monthly view an entry here replaces that month's saved days; the Daily and Weekly tabs are unaffected. See daily_trend.apply_oee_monthly_history().
